claims.text: After needle aspiration or I&D: abx usually cont 10–14 days
claims.quote: Antibiotic treatment following needle aspiration or incision and drainage commonly continues for 10 to 14 days.

claims.text: Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO q6h x7–10 days
claims.quote: Dicloxacillin 500 mg orally every 6 hours for 7 to 10 days

claims.text: PCN allergy: cephalexin 500 mg PO QID x10–14 days
claims.quote: For women allergic to penicillin, cephalexin 500 mg orally 4 times a day or clindamycin 300 mg orally 3 times a day for 10 to 14 days
